message.content: {"status":"completed","observations":[{"kind":"task","text":"任务要求读取本地加急队列备忘录并使用共享 Northwind ERP API，为备忘录中的每个订单生成符合模板的调度控制 JSON；记录按 order_id 排序，货币保留两位小数。","excerpts":[{"ref_id":"ev:381ecea52c12123b6912c0e7:0:672","quote":"For each order in the memo, classify the inventory status, customer exception, final fulfillment decision, next action, SKU exception lists, and shipping quote."},{"ref_id":"ev:381ecea52c12123b6912c0e7:0:672","quote":"Return only JSON matching input/payloads/answer_template.json.\n\nKeep records sorted by order_id. Currency must be rounded to two decimals."}]},{"kind":"observation","text":"可见执行结果片段包含 artifact.records 中至少两个订单的输出。SO-70000 被写为 shortage/backorder，并列出三个 shortage SKU；SO-70007 的记录在可见文本中截断。","excerpts":[{"ref_id":"ev:cafa3e1831f7ccf338ace0d5:0:600","quote":"{\"artifact\": {\"records\": [{\"customer_exception\": \"none\", \"final_decision\": \"backorder\", \"inactive_skus\": [], \"inventory_status\": \"shortage\", \"low_stock_skus\": [], \"next_action\": \"create_backorder\", \"order_id\": \"SO-70000\""},{"ref_id":"ev:cafa3e1831f7ccf338ace0d5:0:600","quote":"\"shortage_skus\": [\"NW-1003\", \"NW-1011\", \"NW-1049\"]}, {\"customer_exception\": \"review_required\", \"final_decision\": \"manual_review\", \"inactive_skus\": [], \"inventory_status\": \"ready\""}]},{"kind":"outcome","text":"任务结果反馈明确标记为 fail。可见评分理由显示订单集合与数量、客户例外和运费报价评分点匹配，但库存与短缺、SKU 例外集合、最终决策和下一步动作评分点未匹配；该理由片段末尾截断。","excerpts":[{"ref_id":"ev:d8d0d6ef08955637f732e689:0:650","quote":"\"outcome\":\"fail\""},{"ref_id":"ev:b1564b8f87528965274ffc77:0:950","quote":"{\"id\":\"SP001_order_set_and_count\",\"matched\":true"},{"ref_id":"ev:b1564b8f87528965274ffc77:0:950","quote":"{\"id\":\"SP002_inventory_statuses_and_shortages\",\"matched\":false"},{"ref_id":"ev:b1564b8f87528965274ffc77:0:950","quote":"{\"id\":\"SP004_customer_exceptions\",\"matched\":true"}]}],"unknowns":["未提供本地 memo、答案模板、ERP 查询请求/响应或完整 artifact，因此无法整理实际 API 动作、完整订单输出、各字段依据或逐订单错误原因。","执行结果正文仅提供前 600 字节，SO-70007 后续字段及其他 records 不可见；不能据此确认记录总数、排序、JSON 完整性或货币格式。","反馈 reason 正文在可见片段中截断，未能引用后续评分点、完整 gaps 或具体纠正说明；目录列出的范围没有提供对应正文，不能作为证据。"],"reason":"基于本次可见 fragments 整理任务、部分执行输出和失败反馈；未将缺失正文、目录引用或截断内容推断为已执行事实。"}
